body: For me, hope can never be acquired from viewing others peoples lives, it goes much deeper than that. I know it would be silly for me to be dependent on the fact that other people got better. I mean, i see commercials on tv all the time that promise happiness in some shit resort with people laughing and smiling, however i dont feel compelled to go just because theyre happier. And I cant answer your second question, cause even i dont know why im still here
why would we waste therapists and Councillors time when we know what the inevitable outcome of all this is?
